text:
The evidence indicates likely native forest loss, but it is not yet corroborated under the tool’s rule.

In 2025, satellite data detected **13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss**, about 3.9% of the property. Of that area, 13.1 hectares were mapped as native forest in Uruguay’s 2021 forest map, and 98% was mapped as forest in the JRC’s 2020 reference.

No later year has yet been observed, so the event cannot be considered corroborated by the tool’s criteria. The evidence does not establish that all native forest on the property has been lost.
